description: Configure date range, inspection status, severity, and name filters to extract Toronto DineSafe inspection records from the City of Toronto's official open data.

daysBack.description: Fetch inspections performed within the last N days.
daysBack.title: Lookback Period (Days)

statusFilter.description: Filter by the inspection outcome assigned by Toronto Public Health.
statusFilter.title: Inspection Status

keyword.description: Optional keyword matched against the establishment name (case-insensitive), e.g. 'SUSHI' or 'PIZZA'.
keyword.title: Establishment Name Keyword (Optional)

minSeverity.description: Only return inspections that include at least one infraction at this severity or higher. Inspections with no infractions are included only when 'all' is selected.
minSeverity.title: Minimum Infraction Severity

maxItems.description: Maximum number of inspection records to extract.
maxItems.title: Max Inspections

title: Toronto DineSafe Inspections Input
